title: Japanese property PDFs into reviewed records

facts: Original requirements in jd.txt; connector capture and name evidence in intake-private.json.
Tokyo real estate development and investment business, with hotel-related projects. Existing tools: HubSpot, Notion, Nutstore, email, Excel and PDFs.
Paid discovery by screen sharing, approximately three ranked opportunities, then one separately agreed pilot, representative testing and team training.
Simon is a client contact named in two separate reviews dated 2025-06-08 and 2024-08-13; ownership is not established.
All PDF text, property details, reviewer identity, confidence values and outputs in this deck are invented illustrations. No source PDF was supplied.
No past Japanese property extraction results, native HubSpot/Notion/Nutstore connections, Japanese language fluency or Japan-hours availability are claimed.

scenes.title: Agree one pilot, then trace a Japanese PDF.
scenes.caption: Paid discovery starts with screen sharing. Rank about three opportunities by impact and effort, then agree one scope.
scenes.beat: I would watch your team process a real example and rank the options with you. The proposed pilot takes a Japanese property PDF through duplicate checks, extraction and a human review hold.
details: Illustrative ranking: property PDFs first, inquiry drafts second, receipt sorting third. Confirm the ranking during discovery.
Begin with sample or anonymized data, limited access and company-owned accounts.
New documents enter extraction and review; repeated documents link the existing record. Failed requests remain held.
